summary: Austria (AT) localization of Business Central 29. It covers Austrian VAT statements and VIES declarations, delivery reminders for late vendor deliveries, the Vendor Payments List, G/L Setup Information, Intrastat, a data export, physical inventory orders, and DACH-shared reports.
overview:
The Austrian layer adds a delivery reminder feature for vendors (terms, levels, texts, header and line tables, issue and create codeunits, test and issued reports). It also adds VAT reporting: report 11110 "VAT Statement AT", report 11108 "VAT - VIES Declaration XML" and codeunit 11110 "Update VAT-AT". Learn describes the VAT statement as producing XML and FDF files for the tax authority, with support for a reduced 4.9% rate from July 1, 2026.

The code also brings a Data Export framework (table 11002 "Data Export" and related pages), Intrastat objects, physical inventory order tables, balance reports, fixed asset reports and DACH report selection (table 26100 "DACH Report Selections"). W1 tables get local fields. Examples: Company Information (tax office, agency and authorization data), General Ledger Setup, Vendor and purchase documents (Registration No.), Fixed Asset (BWR depreciation book and premium depreciation fields) and Exch. Rate Adjmt. Parameters (valuation method). Some W1 objects get new procedures and events, such as codeunit Gen. Jnl.-Post Batch and page VAT Statement Preview Line.

Learn documents the Austrian pages: Austria Local Functionality, VAT reporting, How to Create a VAT Statement, Vendor Payments List, G/L Setup Information, and the delivery reminder setup, generation, issue and test pages. Learn mentions SAF-T only as planned.
key_points: Delivery reminders for vendors: terms, levels, texts, vendor codes, manual creation or generation, test report, issuing
VAT Statement AT (report 11110) with XML/FDF/PDF output and VIES Declaration XML for FinanzOnline submission
Vendor Payments List report with chronological or vendor sorting and Standard, FCY Amounts, Posting Info layouts
G/L Setup Information report prints master data, posting groups, VAT setup and source codes
Data Export framework (tables 11002 to 11010) and Paragraph 131 Export report
Intrastat AT with place of dispatcher and receiver tables and an Intrastat Report Line extension
Physical inventory orders and recordings as own tables, with number series in Inventory Setup
Exchange rate adjustment with valuation method and BilMoG-related procedures

areas.what: Adds the delivery reminder feature: header, line, issued, ledger entry, term, level and text tables, pages, issue and create codeunits, and reports. Also adds Vendor Total-Balance, Vendor Detailed Aging and Vendor Payments List, and fields on Purchases & Payables Setup, Purchase Line and Vendor Templ.
areas.why: Learn describes delivery reminders as a way to notify vendors of overdue deliveries, and the Vendor Payments List as sortable by vendor or date with several layouts.

areas.what: Adds Austrian VAT statement and VIES reports, the Data Export framework, G/L Total-Balance, Provisional Trial Balance and G/L Setup Information. Changes W1 General Ledger Setup, VAT Report Setup, exchange rate adjustment parameters, Gen. Jnl.-Post Batch and VAT Statement Preview Line.
areas.why: Learn documents the VAT Statement in FDF, XML and PDF formats, VIES XML for EU sales, and the G/L Setup Information report for verification and audit.

areas.what: Adds Intrastat AT support (management codeunit, report line extension, place of dispatcher and receiver), physical inventory order and recording tables, and reports such as Item ABC Analysis. Inventory Setup gets number series fields.

Extends Company Information with tax office, agency and authorization fields, and adds DACH report selections and Format Address procedures for the tax office. Adds Source Code Setup for delivery reminders and Document-Print procedures for VAT reports.
Holds the Data Export Setup table, the Intrastat - Item List report, the delivery reminder permission set, and upgrade and sandbox cleanup plumbing.
Adds Austrian fixed asset reports and fields on Fixed Asset (BWR depreciation book code, premium depreciation). FA General Report gets a procedure to exclude reclassification entries.
Extends the LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets and adds delivery reminder permission set extensions.
Changes the Export Contact and Export Segment Contact XMLports compared with W1.
Adds the Customer Total-Balance report and changes the Sales Line Archive table.
Adds the SEPA CT APC export file codeunit for credit transfers.
Adds an Austrian expense event subscriber codeunit.
Adds a DACH page extension for the Manufacturing Manager role center.

issues: Overview says VAT Statement Preview Line is a W1 codeunit. The input lists it as page/475, so the sentence now names it as a page.

Overview puts Fixed Asset next to the 'valuation method' parenthetical. The input gives Fixed Asset BWR Depr. Book Code and premium depreciation fields; valuation method belongs to Exch. Rate Adjmt. Parameters only. The two are now separated.

Overview calls the Data Export framework, Intrastat, physical inventory and balance and fixed asset reports 'DACH-shared'. The input marks only some objects as DACH (DACH Report Selections, SourceCodeSetupDACH, Report Sel. Usage Purch. DACH), so that label has been dropped from the list.
Key point 1 says 'batch creation'. Learn calls this generating delivery reminders, so the key point now uses that wording.
